summary: The pandas editable build failed while compiling the ARM64 NEON SIMD moments sources. Explicit instantiations using xsimd::neon64 did not match the operator signature involving xsimd::neon.
root_cause: The C++ compiler rejected the explicit instantiations of accumulate_moments_simd::operator()<xsimd::neon64> because the candidate template signature using xsimd::neon64 could not match the declared instantiation signature using xsimd::neon.

evidence.reason: This identifies the failed C++ compilation unit.

evidence.quote: ../../pandas/_libs/include/pandas/simd/moments_simd.hpp:255:50: error: explicit instantiation of 'operator()' does not refer to a function template, variable template, member function, member class, or static data member
evidence.reason: This is the compiler's explicit error at the extern template instantiation.

evidence.quote: candidate template ignored: could not match 'Moments (xsimd::neon64, std::span<const double>, int, std::optional<std::span<const uint8_t>>, int) noexcept' (aka 'Moments (xsimd::neon64, span<const double>, int, optional<span<const unsigned char>>, int) noexcept') against 'Moments (xsimd::neon, std::span<const double>, int, std::optional<std::span<const uint8_t>>, int)' (aka 'Moments (xsimd::neon, span<const double>, int, optional<span<const unsigned char>>, int)')
evidence.reason: This directly shows the xsimd::neon64 versus xsimd::neon signature mismatch.

evidence.quote: ../../pandas/_libs/simd/moments_inst_neon.cpp:14:43: error: explicit instantiation of 'operator()' does not refer to a function template, variable template, member function, member class, or static data member
evidence.reason: The corresponding explicit template definition fails for the same reason.
This confirms that the compiler errors stopped the build.

suggested_fix: Make the NEON explicit instantiation declarations and definitions in pandas/_libs/include/pandas/simd/moments_simd.hpp and pandas/_libs/simd/moments_inst_neon.cpp use a type and function signature that exactly match the accumulate_moments_simd::operator() template, resolving the xsimd::neon64 versus xsimd::neon mismatch.
